exposure: travel time to primary healthcare facilities
transfer time to the referral hospital
outcome: maternal mortality from primary postpartum haemorrhage
cohort: This study included 120 mothers who suffered from primary postpartum haemorrhage in Jember district, Indonesia from January 2017 to December 2019, with 40 cases of maternal death and 80 controls.
finding: Only transfer time to the referral hospital was significantly associated with maternal mortality from primary postpartum haemorrhage.
